name: images
title: Images
description: The pictures in a Cloudinary folder. Each picture is placed on the map by the need or product it represents, written as the business's own copy, never as a description of the scene.

files.config.yaml:
# WHAT A PERSON SETS TO RUN THIS PIPELINE: the Import form, rendered by the canvas the way a
# node's config is. Only what the collect step does not know by itself: which folder, which
# tag. The credential is the node's, found by type in the org's store.
configSchema:
  type: object
  required: []
  properties:
    folder:
      type: string
      title: Folder
      description: Only pictures whose public id starts with this. Leave blank for the whole account.
      default: ""
      placeholder: brand/services/
    tags:
      type: string
      title: Tag
      description: Only pictures carrying this tag. Leave blank for all.
      default: ""
"ui:order": [folder, tags]
files.interface.yaml:
# A PIPELINE ON A CANVAS, as a node: the folder may be named by an upstream node instead of
# the form, and its rows go downstream. The collect step's node carries its own credential,
# so this declares none.
inputs:
  - name: signal
    type: object
    description: The folder to read, as { folder, tags }, when wired from an upstream node instead of the form
    required: false

outputs:
  - name: rows
    type: array
    description: The inbox rows this run collected, one per picture, held until they are run
  - name: total
    type: number
    description: How many rows this run collected

credentials: []
files.pipeline.yaml:
unoverse: "1.0"
# A PIPELINE IS THE SOURCE SIDE: how content is collected and which objects it may yield.
# It never knows how an object is built; that is the object's own api/service.yaml. Between
# collect and the map sit the platform's steps, the same for every pipeline and every
# object: known, understand, make detail, match, retire, save (docs/unoverse/data/pipelines/README.md).
# A pipeline fills the collect slot and names its yields. It adds no step of its own.
type: pipeline
name: images

# THE FACE, as a node's node.yaml carries it.
title: Images
description: >-
  The pictures in a Cloudinary folder. Each picture is placed on the map by the need or
  product it represents, written as the business's own copy, never as a description of the
  scene.
whenToUse: >-
  Bring a library of pictures onto the map so an Agent can find the right one for a need,
  a product or a page. Give it the folder, and a tag if only some of the folder is wanted.
  Every picture lands in the inbox, held, until you run it.
category: Pipelines
version: 1.0.0
color: "#3448C5"
logoUrl: https://res.cloudinary.com/sonik/image/upload/v1754502687/gravity/icons/cloudinary_logo.png

# COLLECT: one step, the folder's pictures, through the CloudinaryFiles node. The node
# carries the org's Cloudinary credential, found by type; nothing is repeated here. Pictures
# only: a video or a raw file is not an image.
collect:
  - name: files
    node: CloudinaryFiles
    config:
      folder: "{{ config.folder }}"
      tags: "{{ config.tags }}"
      resourceType: image
      maxFiles: 500

# THE ROW each picture becomes. A row whose content is an `imageUrl` and no text IS the
# picture: the one model call is shown it, with the fields beside it as its metadata
# (docs/unoverse/data/pipelines/README.md layer 1). The source is the picture's own address, which is the
# image object's identity (uniqueBy source_url); the source id is the asset's public id,
# version-free, so a re-upload of the same asset is the same source with new content.

# WHAT THIS PIPELINE MAKES: one image per picture. The picture is the content; the one model
# call is shown it. The source is the picture's own address.
make:
  # EACH PICTURE, READ ONCE: an image.
  - each: "{{ collect.files.files }}"
    sourceUrl: "{{ item.secure_url }}"
    sourceId: "{{ item.public_id }}"
    content:
      imageUrl: "{{ item.secure_url }}"
      title: "return String(item.public_id).split('/').at(-1)"
      folder: "{{ item.folder }}"
      tags: "{{ item.tags }}"
      format: "{{ item.format }}"
      width: "{{ item.width }}"
      height: "{{ item.height }}"
    image: { cardinality: one }
files.test.yaml:
# THE PIPELINE UNDER GUARD: the collect step faked with a fixture listing, the rows it
# yields asserted. Two pictures in, two inbox rows out, each addressed by the picture's
# own URL, identified by its version-free public id, its content the picture and what the
# library says about it, stamped with this pipeline's yields.
testData:
  config:
    folder: brand/services/
    tags: ""
  fake:
    files:
      count: 2
      files:
        - { public_id: brand/services/cashback-card, version: 1751000000, width: 1200, height: 800, format: jpg, resource_type: image, created_at: "2026-07-01T00:00:00Z", tags: [cards], bytes: 123456, folder: brand/services, url: http://res.example.com/image/upload/v1751000000/brand/services/cashback-card.jpg, secure_url: https://res.example.com/image/upload/v1751000000/brand/services/cashback-card.jpg, universalId: 3f1a9c2b7d4e }
        - { public_id: brand/services/branch-visit, version: 1751000001, width: 1600, height: 900, format: png, resource_type: image, created_at: "2026-07-02T00:00:00Z", tags: [], bytes: 234567, folder: brand/services, url: http://res.example.com/image/upload/v1751000001/brand/services/branch-visit.png, secure_url: https://res.example.com/image/upload/v1751000001/brand/services/branch-visit.png, universalId: 9b8c7d6e5f4a }
  expect:
    rows: "return output.rows.length === 2"
    source: "return output.rows[0].sourceUrl === 'https://res.example.com/image/upload/v1751000000/brand/services/cashback-card.jpg'"
    identity: "return output.rows[0].sourceId === 'brand/services/cashback-card' && output.rows[1].sourceId === 'brand/services/branch-visit'"
    picture: "return output.rows.every(r => r.content.imageUrl === r.sourceUrl && r.content.text === undefined)"
    title: "return output.rows[0].content.title === 'cashback-card' && output.rows[0].content.width === 1200 && output.rows[0].content.format === 'jpg'"
    yields: "return output.rows.every(r => r.yields.join(',') === 'image')"
